summary: Upstage's official Solar Pro 2 guide says new Console signups automatically receive $10 in free credits, usable for all Upstage APIs. A default API key is generated upon signup. Current API pricing lists Solar Pro 2, Solar Pro 3 and Solar Mini as ending service on 2026-10-30 (KST); choose a currently supported model such as Solar Pro 4. This future model cutoff is not the expiry of the $10 signup-credit campaign. Neither an enrollment deadline nor a three-month credit-validity period is stated on the loaded official pages. Whether the free grant requires a card is unknown; the pricing page's card information concerns paid credit purchases and is not evidence of free-grant eligibility. Paid credit usage can continue with charges to a registered payment method after credits run out. This grant is distinct from institutional free access and Studio agent free runs.
claim_steps: Create an Upstage Console account using the Log in control; the official guide says $10 in free credits is granted automatically.
On the Getting Started page, copy the default API key generated upon signup to test the APIs.
Use a currently supported model such as Solar Pro 4. Solar Pro 2, Solar Pro 3 and Solar Mini end service on 2026-10-30 (KST); that model cutoff is not the signup-grant expiry.
Check remaining credits and billing settings: usage can continue with charges to a registered payment method after credits run out.
